Zhuang Dongqing transmigrated into a novel.

Zhuang Dongqing couldn’t bring himself to off himself—it hurt too much.
If the Boss could help him out of this world, that’d be fine too.
No way was he going to starve and suffer while having a baby. He’d never been that kind of tragic character.
The Big Boss, ever composed, only said:
“That’s it?”
Scratching his palm, Zhuang Dongqing mumbled:

⸻
Once inside the prince’s manor, life was good.
Food, drink, entertainment—he had it all.
Except… there was one tiny detail he didn’t expect.
One morning, as the sun just began to rise, Zhuang Dongqing wobbled out of bed, dark circles under his eyes, hand trembling as he poured himself a cup of tea.
The moment the warm liquid touched his throat, he felt fingers—long and elegant as jade—part the bed curtains behind him.
“Qingqing, sneaking off again?”
That slow, deliberate voice made Zhuang Dongqing’s spine go stiff.
Clutching his sore waist, Zhuang Dongqing couldn’t help but think:

By the time I made a name for myself in the immortal sects, he was already a demonic cultivation prodigy, his infamy known throughout the lands. He was spirited away by the guardians of the Demonic Realm. After a century in seclusion, he re-emerged as the new Demon Lord—a name that made all who heard it tremble.
As for me, I dragged my broken, ailing body into obscurity, eking out a meager existence in a small, unknown sect, with only a few years left to live.
We met again at a bustling Grand Cultivation Assembly. Countless old acquaintances failed to recognize me, but he spotted me in an instant. Without hesitation, he sent a palm strike flying my way.
With a sickening thud, I was sent flying, vomiting blood, and I fainted on the spot.
When I opened my eyes, he was standing over me, his expression thunderous. “How did you become such a waste?!”
Between wracking coughs that felt like they were tearing my ruined lungs apart, I managed to roll my eyes. “Just as you wished. I’m dying.”
He refused to accept it. He went to incredible lengths to retrieve my long-lost sword, insisting I fight him one more time. Forced to comply, I took it. With a loud clang, the once-familiar blade slipped from my hand and fell to the ground.
His eyes widened in shock. I met his gaze, unflinching.
That’s right. I can’t even hold a sword anymore.
I had long since accepted my fate, but he refused to give up. He became obsessed, forcing priceless immortal elixirs down my throat, searching realms for miracle workers to heal me. While he was at it, he even annihilated the old enemies who had massacred my clan.
I was a little touched. “You’re being so good to me. Don’t tell me you’ve fallen for me?”
“Bullshit!” His face twisted. “I just want to beat you fair and square again! Yan Jingyu, if you’re going to die, you can only die at my hands!”
As my final day drew nearer, he grew so anxious he couldn’t sleep at night, his hair falling out in clumps.
Meanwhile, I ate well and slept soundly. I spent my days strolling through his demonic palace, teasing the local demons and monsters, and lazily awaiting my end.
With half a year left, I saw him sitting on the roof, staring blankly into the distance. I stood below and opened my arms. “Hey! Get me up there!”
He glanced at me, and for once, his usual ferocious cruelty was gone. Wordlessly, he lifted me up with a wave of his hand.
I settled down beside him and, as cheekily as ever, used the nickname he despised. “Liao Xiao Mei*, I’m really dying. You should stop wasting your…”
Before I could finish, this infamous lord of an entire realm lowered his head, and tears began to fall like rain.
Me: “…”
Wait, no— Fine! I’ll train properly, okay? I’ll do my best to get back to my peak before I die and give you that satisfying fight you want!
Hey, hey, hey, just stop crying already…

125526.synopsis:
For eight years, Alpha lover Cha Joowon and Beta Seo Yoonwoo were bound not by pheromones, but by mutual trust.
But one night of betrayal shattered everything — and left Yoonwoo deeply wounded.
“Want me to be honest? That rut I had with that Omega — someone I didn’t even know — was so much more intense and satisfying than any night I ever had with you in those eight years.”
With those cruel words, the man who was once everything to him became part of the past.
Having lost it all, Yoonwoo fled and locked himself away in deep despair.
All that remained was a hardened distrust toward Alphas and Omegas, and a life spent behind emotional walls.
Then one day—
“Um… Are you… Seo Yoonwoo?”
A new Alpha appears — Kim Dojin, gentle and warm, radiating pure admiration.
The younger Alpha begins to seep into Yoonwoo’s wounded heart like sunlight through a crack.
And just as Dojin’s persistent and tender comfort begins to melt his frozen heart… the man from the past returns and knocks once more on the door Yoonwoo had finally started to close.
“Yoonwoo… breaking up with you… every night — no, every moment — I’ve regretted it so much I thought I might die.”
Cha Joowon, now consumed with bitter regret, pleads for another chance.
But even now, the shadow of his unstable relationship with another Omega looms over him.
Caught between past regret and the thrill of something new,
Can Yoonwoo rebuild the broken walls around his heart and finally find happiness?
* * *
“Someone I once dated… when he went into rut, he left me — his partner — and spent the night with an Omega. Then he looked me in the eye and said that one night with that faceless Omega was way more intense and better than any night he ever had with me during our eight years together.”
After a small sigh, Yoonwoo finally spoke the hardest, most selfish truth.
“…My ex… is getting engaged next week. And today… I got a personal invitation from that Omega he’s marrying.”
As the words left his mouth, a blurred flash of that hellish night in the hotel played behind his eyes — two bodies tangled, Joowon’s face lost in pleasure and madness…
That scene still lingered vividly in his mind — a trauma he hadn’t escaped.
“…So I’m thinking of going to the engagement party. …But I just… I don’t have the courage to go alone.”
Dropping his gaze, he struggled to finish the thought.
“So… I know I’m asking a lot, but… Dojin, would you maybe go with me? I’m not asking you to pretend to be my partner or anything. You don’t have to do anything. I just… need someone beside me. Just to be there — in the same space.”
associated_names: The Correlation Between Alpha and Beta

127830.synopsis:
The young crown prince Pilhwan fled for his life, driven to the edge of the world.
There, like a stray dog soaked in the rain, he was picked up and raised by Onju, a pure-blooded Vermilion Bird.
Pilhwan’s small dream of becoming a fine adult and the live-in son-in-law of Onju’s household
was crushed when the emperor came to reclaim his son—destroying Onju’s land in the process.
Thirteen years later, Pilhwan has clawed his way into power within the imperial palace.
Now, with a heart full of atonement and hope, he travels to Dongnae, where Onju lives, to propose.
But he has no idea how much reality has changed.
“I don’t know where you came from, but you’re awfully rude.
Are you treating me like this just because I’m a kid?”
Onju, now a tiny child, greets him like a stranger—
having lost her legs, her wings, and even her memories.
She has completely forgotten that she is a Vermilion Bird,
and lives as the ‘Little Miss’ of a shabby repair shop, never doubting her identity.
While Pilhwan reels in silent shock, a new revelation appears.
“There is a way. All of her energy is sealed within your body.
If you two stay close—really close—she will slowly return to her original self.”
Seeing a glimmer of hope, Pilhwan uses a massive down payment as bait
to invent an excuse to stay stuck to Onju like glue.
“I’d like to formally commission your repair services.”
“What exactly do you want fixed?”
“Hmm. If I had to say… something like ‘justice,’ maybe?”
“You speak of justice with eyes that care nothing for bettering the world. Suspicious.”
Despite her doubts, Onju accepts Pilhwan’s commission.
For some reason, she feels like fun things might happen if she stays with this large, strange man.
And so, their journey together begins.
For Onju, it’s a treasure hunt of adventures.
For Pilhwan, it’s a blood-soaked path of schemes and assassination.
Will Pilhwan succeed in taking the heads of the emperor and empress and safely become the son-in-law of Onju’s household?

139862.synopsis:
Transmigrating to the Qianyuan Continent, Xu Chuan was born with a Blood Lineage Genealogy. As the first generation ancestor, Xu Chuan received three talent bonuses from his destiny patterns.
[Dragon Vigor and Tiger Strength] : Daily energy and abundant qi and blood
[Daily Divination] : Divine fortune and misfortune for each day
[Heaven Rewards Diligence] : Whatever one persists in, one will surely gain
After reaching adulthood, Xu Chuan married, had children, and propagated his descendants. With each new generation, the Blood Lineage Genealogy would generate a new page, giving birth to multiple talent patterns.
[Golden Koi] , [Transparent Sword Heart] , [Divine Farmer’s Hundred Herbs] …
As the Xu family grew increasingly prosperous, more and more miraculous destiny patterns were born: [Azure Emperor Wood Sovereign] , [End of All Arts] , [Martial Ancestor] , [Sword Immortal] …
There were arrow gods who could pierce through the void with a single arrow.
There were formation masters who could create arrays with a single thought.
There were technique masters who could wield ten thousand methods at their fingertips.
…
Prodigies emerged in every generation, competing with the heavens themselves.
The Xu family rose from the lowest common people, emerging from the countryside, advancing step by step, and ultimately became an eternal and immortal clan lasting ten thousand ages.
associated_names: 从族谱命格开始打造长生仙族

142166.synopsis:
In a world where it’s common for card games to bring about the end of the world, I, Tanafuda Mitsuru, who was reincarnated into such a place, finally achieved my dream of becoming a card shop owner.
In this world, where people seem to enjoy card battles more than anything, I simply wanted to watch them up close and share in that joy.
However, for some reason, everyone around me sees me as some kind of former protagonist—a veteran who once resolved a great incident and now watches over the next generation of duelists.
When in truth, I’ve never solved anything remotely close to a major incident.
This is the story of a reincarnator who, after becoming a card shop owner in a world where card games take precedence over everything, is somehow mistaken by everyone as someone who must have once saved the world.
associated_names: カードゲームで世界が滅ぶ世界に転生してカードショップを開店したら、周囲から前作主人公だと思われている

159062.synopsis:
「I’m the type of mob who respawns—that’s me.」
Yo. I’m a bandit. Not a thief, not a mountain brigand… I’m a mob even lower than that. But, for better or worse, I’ve been blessed with a special ability. Believe it or not, no matter how many times I die, I can respawn into the body of another bandit!
I might just be a petty guy who does nothing but die and revive, but truth be told, I have a dream: I want to become one of those adventurers I admire and actually be useful to people. That’s why I occasionally play at being an adventurer and risk my life to help someone out. If it means protecting someone’s future, then throwing away five or six of my lives is a dirt-cheap price to pay.
This is the heroic saga of a nameless mob who keeps chasing his dream, even after dying a million times.
associated_names: A Mob Who Died a Million Times (LN)

205398.synopsis:
Transmigrating into a holographic game as an NPC, Yin Yuehui became a miscellaneous disciple with no talent for cultivation and spiritual roots so thin they couldn’t even be detected. Every day, he was responsible for planting spiritual herbs, helping the cook, assisting the blacksmith, and he even had to learn everything from mining to fishing. As part of his daily routine, he also had to swing his sword thirty thousand times. He was so diligent that even the harshest cultivators couldn’t find a single fault. Yet, despite such hard work, Yin Yuehui’s cultivation level didn’t advance even an inch.
The sect members said this miscellaneous disciple was a bit dim-witted; what was the point of doing so much? He didn’t even know how to slack off. Yin Yuehui, however, just stroked his cat and hummed a tune, appearing completely unbothered.
Only he knew that he had been waiting for a voice.
Finally, one day, a mechanical voice that only he could hear rang out in the sky:
Holographic game [Heavenly Will] has officially launched its open beta. Wishing you a pleasant gaming experience.
From then on, Yin Yuehui added a player identity to his life.
So what if he had no spiritual roots? He would issue tasks to himself, converting experience points into spiritual energy.
So what if his status was low? As an NPC, he possessed the most comprehensive collection of introductory skills in the entire cultivation world. As his cultivation level grew and his status rose, his skill proficiency increased in tandem.
He was the one who reached the pinnacle of the cultivation world, and he was also the number one player.
Everyone said that Yin Yuehui of Feixian Valley was perfect in every way—his appearance and personality were both outstanding—and the only flaw was his “five-element spiritual root,” which lacked any talent. Little did they expect that during the sect competition, this person rumored to have no cultivation talent would overturn all the geniuses of the cultivation world with a single strike of his sword.
After the game update, players were about to face the newly launched boss—Yan Xining. The boss’s strength was shocking; no matter how much effort they expended, they would be wiped out. Let alone clearing the level, even scratching him was a feat.
Until later, players discovered that only those who held a gift from their “Little Martial Brother” could escape unscathed.
Combining this with the data pack titled “The Demon Lord’s Wedding,” some bold individuals had a wicked idea: they quietly used a god-tier weapon to knock Yin Yuehui unconscious and sent him to the Demon Lord’s palace.
Yin Yuehui, who woke up in a luxurious palace, was baffled: “???”
He just took a nap, how did he change maps?
